errors.text_span: Графиката илюстрира промените в процента на продуктите, произведени от първичния сектор, в общия стокообмен за България в периода от 2004 до 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description fails to identify that the figure contains two separate plots, one for "Внос" (Imports) on the left and one for "Износ" (Exports) on the right. It treats the entire figure as a single chart, which is a fundamental misrepresentation of its structure.

When describing the "Общо" (Total) solid line, the description incorrectly assigns it a peak value of over 65%. The "Общо" line never exceeds approximately 42%. The value of over 65% actually corresponds to the "Извън ЕС" (Outside EU) dashed line in the "Внос" (Imports) plot.

The description incorrectly labels the dotted line as "Експорт" (Export). According to the legend, the dotted line represents "ЕС" (EU). "Експорт" ("Износ") is the title of the right-hand plot, not a data series.
The description completely omits the third data series, "Извън ЕС" (Outside EU), which is represented by the dashed line and is a key component of both plots.

errors.text_span: започваща при стойност около 28% през 2004 г.
errors.evidence: The description claims the "Общо" (Total) line starts at around 28% in 2004. In the figure, this line starts at approximately 15% for imports ("Внос") and 23% for exports ("Износ"). The stated value of 28% is incorrect for either plot.

The description states that the dotted line (which represents "ЕС", not "Експорт") reaches a maximum of over 35%. In the figure, this line's peak is approximately 30% in both the import and export plots.
The phrase "тъпа ивица" (which translates to "dull stripe" or "blunt band") is an awkward and unclear way to describe a section where the line flattens or plateaus.
